machine: Apple M3 Mac15,13 macOS26.2; four performance plus four efficiency cores; no builds, tests, profiles or archives during either cohort

timing_boundaries.upstream: Original upstream timer, with global pool preinitialized, retained only as a labeled historical reference.
timing_boundaries.matched_worker_lifecycle: Both implementations create, run and join workers inside processing; JSON decoding excluded. Mech admission is additional and separately reported.
timing_boundaries.whole_process: Parent monotonic clock around fresh subprocess launch through exit, including JSON IO, artifact restoration, admission, computation and teardown. OS file cache is not flushed.
timing_boundaries.post_json: One continuous interval includes input preparation and allocations plus computation and worker create/run/join. Mech supplies post_json_seconds; Rust supplies its documented processing timer. JSON IO and Mech artifact restoration are included in the separate complete-process measurement.

implementations.name: rust
implementations.processing_boundary: JSON decoding outside timer; tag-index and counter allocations, computation and result materialization inside timer; serial implementation.

implementations.name: rust-preinitialized
implementations.processing_boundary: Global eight-thread Rayon pool created before JSON decoding and processing timer; scratch buffers and tag index inside processing timer; no explicit pool teardown in processing timer.

implementations.name: rust-mech-control-streaming
implementations.processing_boundary: JSON decoding outside timer; input flattening and offset/tag-buffer allocations, unchanged numeric generation and result materialization inside timer; serial implementation, no worker pool. Histogram uses one borrowed-key hash pass, sorts only distinct keys; all numeric generation and result materialization unchanged.
